head: de5e89d01c82c8a8f982f604935e3b07dd918fe2

units.subject: stlport: use native SDK declarations when building library sources

native_evidence_identity.reproduction: Commands and exact source/toolchain input identities are retained in the linked commands.json and manifest.json; run-stl-target.py records the existing integration target invocation. These scripts were not executed while packaging.
native_evidence_identity.claim: Source-equivalent recorded native provider build; full integration checkout/project/other providers are separate from this source-only branch.

required_notice: Original README modification notice (+3) and source modification comments retained; no existing copyright or license text removed.
historical_failure_limits: Before SDK inclusion, real dll_main.cpp failed because OutputDebugStringA was undeclared; the local v2 log is preserved.
After SDK inclusion but before undefining legacy __in/__out SAL aliases, the initial full x64 attempt failed in seven of 33 TUs; historical plan retains this finding.
Original 92b05cbd89 records Release 33-TU builds on Win32 and x64; the independently identity-matched raw packet used here is the later native x64 Release provider target.
claim_limits: Only the native Windows non-Cygwin/non-WinCE vendor source prefix changes. Installed STLport headers and allocator implementation/routing are unchanged.
NOMINMAX is defined if absent; windows.h supplies SDK declarations; _STLP_WINDOWS_H_INCLUDED prevents substitute declarations; only legacy __in/__out short aliases are undefined afterward.
No provider selection, x64 project additions, library binaries, SDK files or full client build are part of this PR.
Recorded provider target builds JPEG alongside STLport; that unrelated provider is not imported into this source package.
Debug means the consumer CRT/configuration, not _STLP_DEBUG; no new Debug/STLDebug or runtime/ABI certification is claimed.
No new command in the historical reproduction scripts was executed for packaging.
